description: Audit one set of response headers against a contract the caller states: headers that must be present, headers that must not be, and exact, prefix or substring rules on values. Also reports a header repeated with different values, where which one a client uses varies; an absent Content-Type, which forces a client to sniff; and a textual Content-Type with no charset. Optionally reports absent cache directives and no validator at all, which makes a conditional request impossible. Pay 120000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

contract.description: The rules to apply. An unknown property here is refused rather than ignored.

require_cache_directives.description: Also report an absent or directive-free Cache-Control and the absence of any validator. Defaults to false.

values.description: Per header, either an exact string, or an object with starts_with or contains.

headers.description: The response headers. Names are compared case-insensitively, as HTTP defines them. A repeated header may be an array or a comma-joined string. A header that is absent is omitted; a null value is refused rather than read as present. At most 200 entries.

status.description: The response status, echoed back for correlation. Not used in any finding.

name: http_header_contract_audit

checked.description: How many rules of each kind were applied, so a contract that checked nothing is visible rather than reading as a pass.

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

conformant.description: True only when every declared rule was evaluated and none failed.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: HTTP Header Contract Audit
